ARCWES.RaioHint: Turns on the animated lightning strikes (requires Sequencer and JB2A).
ARCWES.Ciclo: Day and night from world time
ARCWES.CicloHint: The Westruun scene darkness follows the time of day (Simple Calendar or Foundry clock); lights turn on by themselves at night.
ARCWES.P.SoMestre: Only the GM can do this.
ARCWES.P.Ocupado: Westruun is already working. Wait for it to finish.
ARCWES.P.Vazio: Westruun has not been built in this world yet.
ARCWES.P.InstalarTexto: Westruun ({lang}) will be built in this world: the city map, a journal for every location, NPCs with sheet, portrait and token, the interior scenes and the playlists. It takes about a minute.
ARCWES.P.RepararTexto:
This world already has Westruun. Everything will be brought to the current module version without recreating what already exists: NPC portraits and tokens, location images and pages, one scene for every illustration, the credits journal, the map title, lights, clouds and the journal folders. The old Oni's Lair battle map scene is deleted.

Warning: journal pages that came from the module go back to the module text, so anything you wrote inside them is lost. Pages and journals you created are not touched.
ARCWES.P.OrganizarDica: Puts every journal in the right folder (city, wards, NPCs, historical figures), fixes the page order and leaves only the Description open to players. No text is changed.
ARCWES.P.OrganizarFeito: Journals organized: {movidos} moved to another folder and {paginas} pages fixed.
ARCWES.P.RepararDica: Brings portraits, tokens, location images and scenes, credits, the map title and the clouds to the current module version.
ARCWES.P.CampanhaTexto: Deletes every journal, page, NPC and folder marked as ⚑ Campaign. Use it only on the copy you are going to publish. This cannot be undone.
ARCWES.P.ChipFx: FXMaster: clouds over the city, rain, fog and birds. Without it the map has no weather.
ARCWES.P.ChipSeq: Sequencer: animated lightning and the storm cloud over Greystone Tower.
ARCWES.P.ChipJb2a: JB2A (free): the lightning and cloud animations.
ARCWES.P.AvisoClima: No clouds on the map? Enable the FXMaster module: clouds, rain and fog show up by themselves the next time you open the scene.
ARCWES.P.Tagline: New Foundry maps and modules every month.
ARCWES.P.CenaAtivarDica: Takes every player to the scene of this image.
ARCWES.P.CenaVerDica: Opens the scene just for you, without moving the players.
ARCWES.P.CenaCriar: Create the scene for this image
ARCWES.P.CenaSumiu: The scene for this image no longer exists. Use Update and repair in the Westruun panel.
ARCWES.P.ReparoFeito: Westruun is up to date: {cenas} location scenes created and {tokens} placed tokens fixed.
ARCWES.IdiomaHint: Language of the GM panel, these settings, the buttons and the Westruun notices. It does not change the language of journals already created in the world.
ARCWES.ClarosHint: Opens every journal in a light (parchment) theme, without changing the theme of the rest of Foundry.
ARCWES.P.Construindo: Westruun: building the city ({lang}). This takes about a minute.
ARCWES.P.Pronto: Westruun is ready: {locais} locations, {npcs} NPCs, {nomes} names on the map, {luzes} lights and {playlists} playlists.
ARCWES.P.Atualizada: Westruun updated: {npcs} NPCs ({novos} created), {locais} locations ({paginas} pages) and {faixas} tracks.
ARCWES.P.Exportada: Adventure exported ({nome}): {cenas} scenes, {diarios} journals, {atores} actors and {playlists} playlists.
